flow.label: DB Data Fetch
flow.name: taskflow_db_fetch_template
flow.description: Business question → semantic grounding → bounded read-only SQL fetch → verification and caliber notes.

config.goal: Map business nouns in the user's question to tables/columns/calibers: query metadata and bounded samples with sql_query (schema, distinct/limit samples; no full scans); when multiple calibers exist, list candidates and state the default choice with reasoning. Output a query plan: per-step SQL draft plus expected columns and row caps.

Execute the upstream query plan with sql_query; on errors, fix the SQL from the observation and retry (never change the caliber); output row count/column overview plus a sample of key rows; minimal extra queries allowed if the plan has gaps.

Spot-check the upstream result independently: verify key numbers via a different aggregation path or reverse sample lookup; explain the caliber and its limits (time window/filters/aggregation grain/null handling). Output a verification verdict (confirmed/corrected) plus a caliber note.
